description: lightsim2grid, published by Grid2Op, supplies a C++ power-flow backend for Grid2Op and an alternative pandapower Newton solver, with several power-flow algorithms and input formats. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MPL-2.0. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README warns against using this package for detailed power-system computations beyond its intended backend role. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The provider explicitly documents replacing model-pandapower's Newton power-flow routine.
